notes: Flags: none (boxed for home assembly, 'Effortless Assembly', so F-22 does not apply). A headboard-less platform the size of the mattress: the 76" King mattress overhangs the 75.5" frame by 1/4" on each side. 'Ground To Item Distance 8.5 inches', and one photo shows a robot vacuum underneath. 'Maximum Weight Recommendation 1000 pounds'. Natural pine with a 3.5" solid wood frame and wooden slats, no box spring needed; care 'Spot cleaning with a damp cloth'. Fit (the king brief, master-bedroom, re-fit 2026-10-25 for the heater's measured 3" and the bathroom door's 30" landing): headboard side on the right wall, its mattress filling the 76" between 24" off the heater's face (y 27, F-34) and the landing (y 103, F-31), so the frame stands at y 27.25-102.75 and the mattress at y 27-103, 24" from the heater's face (F-33: 12" for bedding). It is the narrowest frame read and the only king that leaves the window side its 24" (until 2026-10-25, with a 36" landing and the heater drawn 6", it had 15.5": tight). 79.5" long, so it leaves 97.5" of the room's 177". 4.6 stars (22,813). In Stock (2026-10-24). Brand Mellow (manufacturer Best Price Mattress), part BPM-CSWPB-12KN. Mellow also sells it in Espresso (search result B07DZW2PNH, $200.16, not opened). rooms: master-bedroom, from the king brief.
